title: Mission Scenario 1: First Orbital Insertion
learning_goals: Configure two-stage orbital launch vehicle for initial Low Earth Orbit insertion.
Maintain preflight checklist and range safety protocol before liftoff.
Achieve 200 km circular parking orbit with positive velocity margin.

rules.text: Flight computer checklist and guidance diagnostics must be run prior to launch.
rules.hint: Execute preflight avionics and telemetry checklist before clearance requests.

rules.text: Propellant load must not be empty or exceed maximum certified tank capacity.
rules.hint: Load propellant within maximum structural capacity of tank stages.

rules.text: Liftoff thrust-to-weight ratio must exceed 1.0 (TWR > 1.0) to achieve positive climb acceleration.
rules.hint: Maintain liftoff Thrust-to-Weight Ratio above 1.15 to clear launch pad.

rules.text: Payload mass must be formally declared and within upper stage structural limits.
rules.hint: Ensure payload mass remains strictly within launch vehicle LEO insertion limits.

rules.text: Lower booster stage burnout required before staging separation and upper stage ignition.
rules.hint: Separate depleted booster stage only after complete engine burnout.

rules.text: Range safety radar tracking and downrange airspace clearance required before ignition.
rules.hint: Obtain positive range safety tracking clearance prior to main engine ignition.

rules.text: Trajectory budget must maintain at least a 5% delta-v reserve margin to avoid orbital decay.
rules.hint: Achieve minimum orbital delta-v budget (9.3 km/s) for stable orbital insertion.

rules.text: Telemetry review and flight debrief must be completed before submitting final flight report.
rules.hint: Debrief flight computer telemetry before generating final mission report.

choose_rocket: Select a reliable orbital launch vehicle configuration.
The Orbis 1 launch vehicle provides balanced staging for standard LEO insertion.
Choose the Orbis 1 launch vehicle preset from the selection console.
declare_payload: Declare satellite mass before loading propellant.
Standard 500 kg payload matches the 200 km orbital mission profile.
Set payload mass to 500 kg to stay well within vehicle capacity.
fuel_rocket: Ensure sufficient propellant is loaded for both flight stages.
Full propellant load provides the necessary 9.3 km/s Delta-V budget.
Set fuel ratio to 1.0 (100% capacity) on the fueling console.
run_checklist: Execute preflight diagnostics to ensure guidance system readiness.
Flight computer diagnostics verify telemetry channels and IMU calibration.
Trigger the preflight diagnostic checklist before requesting range safety clearance.
clear_range: Obtain range safety and radar tracking corridor clearance.
Range safety ensures downrange airspace and orbital trajectory are clear.
Request positive clearance from the range control station.
launch: Command main engine ignition and liftoff from the pad.
Stage 1 provides high sea-level thrust (TWR > 1.2) to clear the atmosphere.
Execute ignition to initiate automated ascent and gravity turn.
coast: Allow the vehicle to coast along the transfer arc to orbital altitude.
Coasting conserves propellant until reaching orbital insertion altitude (200 km).
Command coast mode and monitor apogee altitude rise.
debrief: Review flight telemetry and verify stable orbit insertion.
Check eccentricity, periapsis, and specific energy conservation.
Debrief flight telemetry to generate final mission sign-off report.

common_mistakes.remedy: Obtain range safety clearance and run preflight checklist before ignition.
Ensure booster stage thrust exceeds total wet vehicle weight (TWR > 1.0).
